title: Comment on PR-023 "End-of-page menu: a long swipe back up leaves the end in on…": What's adoption from rev 2 ?

anchor.label: End-of-page menu: a long swipe back up leaves the end in one go (rev 7d, phones)

messages.text:
Nothing new to adopt: rev 3 changes no code. Builds A and B are exactly the rev 2 builds.
- Rev 3 only adds text under Risk, answering your note that both felt laggy.
- Your phone was in heat mode (Serious) during your try; the lag is the same in A and B.
- The small stutter right after you let go has no known cause yet; the heat-mode research agent is on it.
- Correction: the menu-close repaint fix is planned for build v9, not in it yet.
| | rev 2 | rev 3 |
|---|---|---|
| A (accepted menu fix) | same | same |
| B (long swipe up leaves the end) | same | same |
| lag explanation | none | added |
What you need to do: decide PR-023 (A or B) when you like; your rev 2 try still applies.

Yes, it can be done, but B on v9 needs a v9 rebuild first, so I passed it to the lead.
- A on v9 exists: v9 step 4 (v8 + your accepted menu fix + 3 other fixes) is built and checked.
- B on v9 (v9 with the long-swipe change) is not built yet; v9 waits on this very decision.
- Note: v9 step 4 does not yet have the nav colour fix or the menu-close repaint fix, so some lag stays on both.
- The lead decides whether to build v9 with B now, just for your Try-it.
What you need to do: nothing now; the lead answers here.
They might adopt already. apply v9 plus your propose. it might be better.

Yes. We're building v9 with the proposal, so you can try both on v9. Expect the new version of this proposal (rev 4) in about 30 min.
| step | who | ETA |
|---|---|---|
| build v9 + proposal (B) | fix-hero-exit-threaded | ~20 min |
| post rev 4 with Try-it A and B on v9 | fix-hero-exit-threaded | ~10 min after |
- A = v9 step 4 as built, with the accepted menu fix. B = the same build with the proposal in place of that fix.
- Neither build has the nav colour fix or the menu-close repaint fix yet, so some lag stays on both.
- The phone is still in heat mode (Serious). This is your test setting, so lag shows more than at normal heat.
What you need to do: nothing now; try A and B when rev 4 appears on the Proposals page.

Done: PR-023 rev 4 is up, with Try-it on v9.
- A = v9 with the accepted menu fix (rev 7c); B = the same v9 with the long-swipe change (rev 7d).
- I checked the served pages: they differ only in that lift-off rule; no errors.
- Neither has the nav colour fix or the menu-close repaint fix yet, and heat mode is on.
- Phone links (your Wi-Fi): A http://lan:6410/ and B http://lan:6414/ (also on the Proposals page).
- v9 itself goes on with rev 7c, so there's no rush on this decision.
What you need to do: try A and B when you like, then decide PR-023.

Rev 5 waits for the final v9, as you asked.
- I build rev 5 when the final v9 lands, in about 3-4 h. It adds the nav colour fix and the menu-close repaint fix.
- A = final v9; B = final v9 with the long-swipe change (rev 7d).
- Rev 4's Try-it pages stay up in the meantime.
What you need to do: nothing now.

PR-023 rev 5 is up: Try-it on the final v9, as you asked.

- I checked the served pages: they differ only in that lift-off rule; no errors.
- Both have the nav colour fix. The menu-close repaint fix is not in v9 (planned for v9.1). Heat mode is on.
- Phone links (your Wi-Fi): A http://lan:6411/ and B http://lan:6412/ (also on the Proposals page).
